_readme: Email configuration for the Volleyball Scoring Platform.
The APP renders and sends these emails itself (src/lib/email.ts) when SMTP
without SMTP it falls back to Supabase's default mailer and its fixed
wording. Edit these files + the .html templates, commit and push — the
auto-deploy picks them up. No code changes needed.
Available tokens inside the .html files and subjects:
[FIRST_NAME]         the person's first name (falls back to 'there')
[ACCESS_DETAILS]     what they were granted (global / tenant + role)
[LINK_EXPIRY_HOURS]  the number below (24h is also set on the real links)

invite.subject: Welcome to the Volleyball Scoring Platform

recovery.subject: Set your Volleyball Scoring Platform password
